items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5 — near-frontier intelligence at half the price of Fable 5
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Opus 5：接近 Fable 5 智能、約半價上市
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026. It is available today as the new default on Claude Max and the strongest model on Claude Pro. The model delivers performance close to Claude Fable 5 at roughly half the price (same token pricing as Opus 4.8), with major gains on coding (Frontier-Bench, CursorBench), agentic tasks, ARC-AGI-3 (approximately 3× the next-best model), life sciences and alignment. A Fast mode runs about 2.5× default speed.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 7 月 24 日宣布 Claude Opus 5 即日起可用，成為 Claude Max 預設模型與 Pro 最強模型。它在智能上接近 Claude Fable 5，卻約半價（定價與 Opus 4.8 相同），在編碼（Frontier-Bench、CursorBench）、代理任務、ARC-AGI-3（約次佳模型 3 倍）、生命科學與對齊等方面大幅提升，並提供約 2.5 倍速的 Fast 模式。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release strengthens Anthropic’s position in the high-value but cost-sensitive mid-to-high tier, potentially shifting economics for heavy agentic and enterprise workloads. Real-world sustained performance and rate-limit behavior versus the claimed benchmarks remain to be verified at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此次發布強化 Anthropic 在「高性價比前沿」定位，可能改變重度代理與企業工作負載的成本結構。真實工作負載表現與使用額度是否跟上宣傳仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Claude Opus 5 is available today. It’s a thoughtful and proactive model that comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Opus 5 即日起可用。它是一個深思且主動的模型，智能接近 Claude Fable 5，卻僅半價。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral and 20+ organizations release open letter defending open-weight AI models
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral 等 25+ 組織發布公開信捍衛開源權重 AI 模型
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 a coalition of more than 25 organizations including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral, Hugging Face, IBM, Y Combinator, Andreessen Horowitz, Dell, Palantir and others published the letter “Open Weights and American AI Leadership.” It argues open-weight models expand access, strengthen competition and safety through transparency, and support American AI leadership, urging policymakers to avoid premature restrictions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral、Hugging Face、IBM、Y Combinator、a16z、Dell、Palantir 等超過 25 個組織發布《Open Weights and American AI Leadership》公開信，主張開源權重模型能擴大獲取、透過透明審查強化競爭與安全，並支持美國 AI 領導地位，呼籲政策制定者避免過早限制。
items_flat.analysis_en: The letter marks a rare public alignment of major closed-model ecosystem players, open-source advocates and the leading GPU maker against broad restrictions on open weights. It reframes openness as a safety and sovereignty advantage rather than primarily a risk, though its practical impact on upcoming regulation remains uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是閉源生態、開源社群與 GPU 領導者罕見公開結盟，將 open weights 重新定位為安全與主權優勢。是否真正影響後續監管仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Our AI leadership will be judged not by one frontier AI model, but by whether the United States builds a strong, open ecosystem that diffuses into every sector.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的 AI 領導地位將不以單一前沿模型來評判，而在於美國是否建立能擴散至各產業的強大開放生態系。

items_flat.title_en: xAI launches free Grok add-on for Google Workspace
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出免費 Grok Google Workspace 外掛
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 xAI released a free add-on that places Grok in a side panel inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides. Users can analyze data and write formulas in Sheets, turn outlines into presentations with research and images in Slides, and draft or edit documents while preserving style in Docs. It is available via a single install from the Google Workspace Marketplace (Microsoft 365 versions also exist).
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 於 2026 年 7 月 24 日推出免費外掛，讓 Grok 以側邊欄形式整合進 Google Docs、Sheets 與 Slides。Sheets 可分析資料並撰寫公式、Slides 可從大綱生成含研究與圖片的簡報、Docs 可起草與潤稿並維持風格。一次從 Google Workspace Marketplace 安裝即可使用（亦有 Microsoft 365 版本）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move embeds Grok directly into daily productivity workflows, competing for the same surface occupied by Gemini and Copilot. It is a practical distribution play rather than a capability leap.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將 Grok 直接嵌入日常生產力工具，與 Gemini、Copilot 正面競爭工作流入口，是務實的分發策略而非能力飛躍。
items_flat.quote: Today we're bringing Grok into Google Workspace. One add-on puts Grok beside the file you have open in Sheets, Slides, and Docs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們把 Grok 帶進 Google Workspace。一個外掛就能讓 Grok 出現在你開啟的 Sheets、Slides 與 Docs 檔案旁邊。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Frontier Red Team publishes Project Pilot on AI models controlling real drones
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 前線紅隊發表 Project Pilot：測試 AI 模型操控真實無人機
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team (with Andon Labs) released research evaluating whether frontier models can autonomously control a quadcopter drone for locate-and-follow tasks. They introduced Drone-Bench covering reconstruction, localization, navigation, detection and following. Among 15 models tested, Claude Fable 5 performed best but still failed some navigation steps; the team estimates reliable end-to-end performance remains roughly six months away.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，Anthropic 前線紅隊（與 Andon Labs 合作）發表研究，評估前沿模型能否自主操控四軸無人機執行定位與跟隨任務。新推出的 Drone-Bench 涵蓋重建、定位、導航、偵測與跟隨。在 15 個受測模型中 Claude Fable 5 表現最佳，但仍有導航失敗情況；團隊估計可靠端到端能力大約還需六個月。
items_flat.analysis_en: The work documents concrete progress of language models into physical-world agency and surfaces dual-use governance questions around surveillance-capable autonomy before systems become reliably competent.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 研究具體記錄語言模型進入物理世界代理的進展，並在系統變得可靠前就浮現監控型自主能力的雙重用途治理問題。

Anthropic also published drone-control research.
brief_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Opus 5，接近 Fable 5 智能卻約半價，編碼與代理能力大幅提升。NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral 等 25+ 組織聯名公開信捍衛開源權重模型。xAI 推出免費 Grok Google Workspace 外掛。Anthropic 同步發表無人機操控研究。
